correctness.rationale: An M-adic cylinder's length changes by prepending or stripping a leading digit, with saturation at depth zero. Work modulo a finite set of vertical endpoints at each finite time; the width is not affected by their conventions. A base cylinder of prescribed labels has length the product of its branch lengths, giving the iid reflected walk. Unrolling the recursion gives K_n=S_n−min_{k≤n}S_k; reversal makes its law the running maximum. Reflect at first passage to z, with probability ratio (q/p)^(z−k) for an original endpoint k<z, subtract consecutive maximum CDFs, and tilt the remaining tail by interchanging p and q. The z=0 version is the identity from endpoint sign reversal and gives the j=0 atom. Independently enumerated weighted coin words for four biases up to n=9, checking 260 masses including the first out-of-support mass; finite replay: /workspace/branches/record1_reflection_check.js. For fixed j exactly one of j,j+1 matches the parity, so the binomial Stirling limit contributes 2φ(2η); the tilted term contributes −4ηΦ(−2η). The log-n truncation bounds the tilt uniformly and the remaining geometrically weighted tail is negligible. The functional CLT yields the weak drifted maximum law (not the weighted local limit). Detailed balance gives the geometric stationary law for p<q; positive drift forces K_n→∞; at zero drift unbounded positive excursions and successive new minima give the asserted liminf and limsup. Frozen support was inspected, not executed. No uniformity in a growing η range is claimed.

evidence: The Pelikan record states the full shell transform G(z,u), with r=z(P+Qr²) and P(z) there denoting boundary occupancy. Multiplying by 2−u removes the geometric initial shell; substituting its boundary solution and cancelling yields H(z,u)=r/[Pz(1−r)(1−(Q/P)ru)], the full depth transform. Denisov–Sakhanenko–Wachtel instead assume centered increments and a uniformly vanishing scaled boundary; re-centering this biased walk introduces an order-one linear boundary, so that general theorem is not the coverage basis.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The full indexed transform dominates the all-M calculation, because it is valid as a formal series with a free height variable. The broader-looking first-passage theorem has different scaling assumptions and was not used to reject the claim.

evidence: Expanding H as r times the two geometric factors gives for m=n+1: E[u^K_n]=(Pm)^−1 E[S_m^+ Σ_{j=0}^{S_m^+−1}(Qu/P)^j], where S_m is the sign sum with up probability P. This follows by the comparator's exact ballot extraction for r^k. Each height atom is the coefficient of u^j; the frozen reflection formula is another representation of those same coefficients. Near P=1/2−η/√n, for each fixed u<1 the geometric-series ratio stays below 1; the weighted remainder is bounded, and the comparator's CLT gives √n E[u^K_n]→2E[(Z−2η)^+]/(1−u). This is the frozen prefactor at every u=1/M.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Nothing beyond the same generating function, ballot coefficient and CLT with the free variable evaluated at another weight is required for the main finite-time and critical-mean claims. The weak Brownian maximum is a routine functional-CLT consequence of path reversal, and the absorbed-walk correlation theorem is a different observable and does not establish coverage.

evidence: Let P be the Pelikan doubling probability and Q=1−P its halving probability. Starting uniformly, a fixed word of maps preserves uniformity on [0,2^−K_n): halving increments K; doubling decrements it with saturation. Conditional shell index J_n satisfies J_n=K_n+G in distribution with independently geometric G of mass 2^−j−1. Setting P=1−p gives the frozen walk. In particular the frozen M=2 mean is exactly twice the Pelikan coordinate mean at every n under this parameter identification, not merely proportional in the limit.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The observable difference is removed at M=2 by conditional integration on the image cylinder. At arbitrary M only the scalar weight u=1/M changes, not the depth law.

evidence: The exact indexed critical-window theorem gives F(α)=2φ(2α)+4αΦ(2α), with α=−η under the change of branch convention. The neutral periodic-fiber comparator counts periodic sets in 3D, not complete initial images. The saturated-fiber comparator treats the same leading-digit action in the original 3D map, with fixed up bias 2/3, and only the full-width event (plus exceptional-set results).

originality.rationale: The strongest distinct indexed match is not merely a coincident Gaussian numerator for a different observable. Under the Pelikan dynamics, conditioning on map choices leaves a uniform point on [0,2^−K_n), where K_n is exactly the same reflected walk with up probability equal to the contraction probability. The indexed Pelikan source works out the full bivariate shell generating function, not just its value for the physical-coordinate mean. Dividing out the independent initial geometric shell gives the entire reflected-depth generating function, independent of M. This recovers the frozen finite-time law as coefficients and gives the all-M critical-window mean by exactly the cited comparator's ballot and positive-part Gaussian calculation at u=1/M. The original 3D fiber comparator also has the same digit mechanism with M=2 and a fixed bias. The remaining fixed-drift and weak Brownian consequences are standard. This is a failure for equivalent coverage, not a claim that the later catalog entry was disclosed first or that either record depends on the other.
residual_risks: The relationship and actual disclosure order of the equivalently covering records are not established. The catalog date of the Pelikan comparison is later than that displayed for the frozen entry.
The identified equivalence does not render the distinct periodic-set or exceptional-set results interchangeable with this theorem.

value.rationale: The ensemble width of an initial fiber is naturally motivated, and a weak Brownian limit alone would not give its sharp mean. After accounting for the complete depth transform and its critical-window evaluation in the equivalent model, however, the residue is the direct digit-cylinder interpretation with a different geometric weight, a classical reflection reexpression, and routine weak-limit/fixed-drift consequences. No separate new exact invariant or substantive surviving mechanism is established by that specialization.
